name: GoCardless
line: Bank debit payments for recurring and one-off sales.

free.text: Pay as you go; no base fee for most

cells.countries: US, UK, Eurozone and nine other countries
cells.payout: UK debit: 3 business days to charge, then 2 for bank

fee.math: A US ACH debit (a payment taken from a US bank account), with a fee capped at $5. GoCardless has no cards, so this is bank debit.
A UK Bacs debit (a direct debit from a UK bank account), with a fee capped at £4. No cards are taken, so this is bank debit.
A German SEPA debit (a euro direct debit), with a fee capped at €1. No cards are taken, so this is bank debit.
India is not one of the countries where GoCardless sellers can sign up.
